problems.title: Kth Largest Element in a Stream
problems.notes: maintain a fixed-size min-heap of size k; the root is always the kth largest seen so far

problems.title: Kth Largest Element in an Array
problems.notes: quickselect gives average O(n) vs a heap's O(n log k) — state the tradeoff and the worst-case quickselect risk

problems.title: Top K Frequent Elements
problems.notes: bucket sort by frequency beats a heap for true O(n) — frequency is bounded by array length, so buckets are cheap

problems.title: Top K Frequent Words
problems.notes: tie-break lexicographically when frequencies match — the heap comparator gets fiddly, know it cold

problems.title: Sort Characters By Frequency
problems.notes: bucket-by-frequency then expand each bucket — the same skeleton as Top K Frequent Elements, applied to all elements

problems.title: Furthest Building You Can Reach
problems.notes: greedy + min-heap: spend ladders on the biggest jumps encountered, fall back to bricks for the rest

problems.title: Find K Pairs with Smallest Sums
problems.notes: seed the heap with (nums1[i], nums2[0]) pairs, push (i, j+1) on every pop — a top-k problem shaped like k-way merge

problems.title: Find the Kth Largest Integer in the Array
problems.notes: numbers are given as strings that overflow normal integer types — compare by length first, then lexicographically
